name: B10-0459/2025 (S&D) – Polarisation and increased repression in Serbia, one year after the Novi Sad tragedy
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the polarisation and increased repression in Serbia, one year after the Novi Sad tragedy
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on events in Serbia one year after 16 people died when a railway station roof collapsed in Novi Sad. It condemns police violence against peaceful protesters, attacks on journalists and students, and pressure on universities. It asks Serbia to investigate abuses, hold fair elections and protect media freedom. It also asks the European Union to send a fact-finding mission and consider sanctions on those responsible.

- No law changes; Parliament calls for investigations, a fact-finding mission and possible sanctions.
- It concerns Serbia's government, police, judiciary, media and protesters, plus European Union institutions.
- Next: European Union bodies and member states decide whether to act on these requests.
